# Greener-Dalii · 格润达理

> Intelligence is no longer scarce. Leverage is the new company.
> 智力不再稀缺。杠杆才是新的公司。

## About

Greener-Dalii (格润达理) turns what you know into leverage. We are a small team with company-scale reach — everything open source, every number public, running on our own stack.

## Products

- obsidian-llm-wiki: A local-first Obsidian plugin that turns your files into a queryable knowledge base where every answer cites its source.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/obsidian-llm-wiki
- Shift-Router (for Pi): Two-tier model routing for the Pi coding agent — everyday turns on affordable models, automatic step-up when it matters, zero runtime dependencies.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/pi-shift-router
  - https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-shift-router
  - https://shiftrouter.greenerai.top
- DSH Shift-Router (for DeepSeek Harness): The same two-tier design adapted for DeepSeek Harness.
  - https://github.com/green-dalii/dsh-shift-router
